result.instructions: Tools for Coinbase, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is the current price and 24-hour change of BTC-USD?"; "Show my account balances and the value of each portfolio."; "List my filled orders from the last 7 days with their fees.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Coinbase data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run coinbase_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run coinbase_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run coinbase_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. coinbase_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: coinbase_get_server_time
tools.title: Get server time
tools.description: Get Coinbase's current server time. Public endpoint. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/time.

tools.name: coinbase_list_products
tools.title: List market products
tools.description: List tradable products (spot pairs, futures, equities) with price, 24h volume and status. Public endpoint. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/market/products.

product_ids.description: Only these product ids, for example ["BTC-USD"].

tools.name: coinbase_get_product
tools.title: Get a market product
tools.description: Get one product: base and quote currency, latest price, 24h change and volume, trading status. Public endpoint. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/market/products/{product_id}.

tools.name: coinbase_get_product_candles
tools.title: Get price candles
tools.description: Get OHLCV candles for one product. start and end are Unix timestamps in seconds. Public endpoint. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/market/products/{product_id}/candles.

tools.name: coinbase_get_market_trades
tools.title: Get recent market trades
tools.description: Get the most recent public trades and the best bid and ask for one product. Public endpoint. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/market/products/{product_id}/ticker.

tools.name: coinbase_get_product_book
tools.title: Get the order book
tools.description: Get the public order book (bids and asks) for one product. Public endpoint. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/market/product_book.

tools.name: coinbase_get_key_permissions
tools.title: Get API key permissions
tools.description: Show what the connected CDP key may do (view, trade, transfer) and its portfolio id. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/key_permissions.

tools.name: coinbase_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the account balances (available, hold and total value per currency) in the connected portfolio. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/accounts.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page (cursor field of the last response).

retail_portfolio_id.description: Portfolio id, if the key has more than one.

tools.name: coinbase_get_account
tools.title: Get an account
tools.description: Get one account by its UUID, with balances. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/accounts/{account_uuid}.

tools.name: coinbase_list_portfolios
tools.title: List portfolios
tools.description: List the portfolios the key can see, with their type and id. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/portfolios.

tools.name: coinbase_get_portfolio_breakdown
tools.title: Get a portfolio breakdown
tools.description: Get one portfolio's positions and total value, in one currency. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/portfolios/{portfolio_uuid}.

currency.description: Currency for the totals, for example USD.

tools.name: coinbase_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List historical orders, filtered by product, status, side and date. Use cursor to page. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/orders/historical/batch.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page (cursor field of the last response).

tools.name: coinbase_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one historical order by its id, with its status and details. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/orders/historical/{order_id}.

tools.name: coinbase_list_fills
tools.title: List fills
tools.description: List trade fills (executions) with price, size, fee and time. Use cursor to page. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/orders/historical/fills.

order_ids.description: Only fills of these order ids.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page (cursor field of the last response).

tools.name: coinbase_get_transaction_summary
tools.title: Get transaction summary
tools.description: Get the account's transaction summary (fee tier, volume and fees) for the connected key. Advanced Trade API: GET /api/v3/brokerage/transaction_summary.

product_venue.description: Filter by venue: CBE spot, FCM US futures, INTX perpetuals.

prompts.title: Get started with Coinbase
prompts.description: What you can do with Coinbase here, with example requests to try.
